description: This file defines the FraudDetectorClient class for interacting with the Amazon Fraud Detector service in AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to fraud detection, such as creating, deleting, and describing detectors, models, variables, and other related entities. The class extends the AwsClient base class, indicating it is a specialized client for a specific AWS service.
